item.title: MEC confirms residents are without power in Cass County
item.description: CASSOPOLIS, Mich. -- Midwest Energy and Communications (MEC) confirmed about 1,189 customers are out of power in Fabius, Jefferson, Porter (Cass County), Calvin, and Ontwa townships.

item.title: Penn High School principal addresses offensive language during live stream
item.description: MISHAWAKA, Ind. -- Penn High School's principal, Rachel Fry, released a statement Saturday regarding the offensive language used in a student's live stream at Friday's sectional basketball game between Penn and Riley high school.

item.title: Nation Weather Service preliminary tornado reports
item.description: MICHIGAN. -- More information of yesterday's storms in Southwest Michigan is being provided from the National Weather Service's Preliminary Storm report.

item.title: Edwardsburg American Legion serving meals to families after tornados
item.description: EDWARDSBURG, Mich. -- The Edwardsburg American Legion will be serving meals to families of crew members who have been hit by the severe storms.

item.title: Tornado kills 12-year-old in Cass County, residents say storm came with no warning
item.description: EDWARDSBURG, Mich. -- Following Friday afternoon’s severe weather, many in Edwardsburg spent Saturday cleaning debris while crews worked on clearing streets and removing fallen poles.

item.title: Local barber reflects on friendship with legendary Lou Holtz
item.description: SOUTH BEND, Ind. -- After coming over from Italy at 22 years old, 87-year-old Armando Femia built an impressive career and clientele cutting hair in South Bend.

item.title: Indiana Michigan Power makes progress with storm restoration
item.description: THREE RIVERS, Mich. -- Indiana Michigan Power confirmed as of 9 p.m. the majority of residents who lost power from Friday's storm have been restored.

item.title: United Way of Southwest Michigan announces care fund following deadly tornadoes
item.description: ST. JOSEPH. Mich. -- United Way of Southwest Michigan has activated the Southwest Michigan Cares Fund to support recovery efforts across the impacted region to support United Ways serving the affected communities after the tornadoes struck Cass, St. Joseph, and Branch counties.

item.title: Three Rivers Health assess damage from severe weather
item.description: THREE RIVERS, Mich. -- Three Rivers Health issued a statement Saturday stating the team continues to assess the damage to the hospital and several facilities on the campus from the severe weather that swept through the region.

item.title: Two-vehicle crash at intersection of C.R. 142 and Division Street
item.description: ELKHART, Ind. -- A 2004 Honda Accord was traveling westbound on C.R. 142, when it stopped at a stop sign at the intersection of C.R. 142 and Division Street.
